between four people for the motel snack break.Shower curtain ring onion ringsButtermilk soaked onion rings in crisp golden beer batter.Named for Del's trunk full of samplesHow to make it2 brown onions150ml buttermilk120g plain flour150ml lager1/4 tsp salt1 L neutral oil, for fryingSlice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.Whisk the flour, lager and salt into a batter.Heat the oil to 185°C.Drain the rings, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden.Drain and serve hot.MainsThanksgiving turkey slidersRoast turkey with cranberry, baked stuffing and gravy in soft buns.Neal brings Del home for Thanksgiving dinnerHow to make it700g turkey breast30g salt1 L cold water150g stuffing mix20g butter20g plain flour300ml chicken stock8 soft slider buns80g cranberry sauceDissolve the salt in the water, submerge the turkey and refrigerate for 6 hours.Drain, pat dry and roast at 170°C until the centre reaches 70°C for 2 minutes.Make the stuffing mix with the packet water amount, spread in a small dish and bake beside the turkey, then cut into squares.Rest the turkey and slice.Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, whisk in the stock and simmer for gravy.Fill the buns with turkey, cranberry sauce, stuffing squares and a spoonful of gravy.Del's Wichita fried chicken and mashCrumbed chicken, creamy mash, peppery white gravy and green beans.Del knows a place in every town on the wayHow to make it2 large chicken breasts, halved and flattened100g plain flour2 eggs120g panko breadcrumbs150ml vegetable oil1kg potatoes60g butter300ml milk300g green beans1 tsp cracked black pepperBoil the potatoes until soft, then mash with half the butter and 100ml milk.Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko. Fry until golden and cooked through.Melt the rest of the butter in the pan, stir in 2 tbsp of the flour, then whisk in the rest of the milk and the pepper for the gravy.Boil the beans and serve with the chicken, mash and gravy.SweetsThanksgiving pumpkin pieSpiced roast pumpkin custard in pastry, served with whipped cream.A plane, a train, a bus, a burnt car and a truck laterHow to make it450g peeled pumpkin250g sweet shortcrust pastry2 eggs80g brown sugar200ml thickened cream1/2 tsp cinnamon1/4 tsp ground ginger1/4 tsp nutmegRoast the pumpkin at 200°C until soft, then puree.Line a 20cm pie dish with the pastry and blind-bake with paper and weights at 180°C, then remove the weights and bake again.Whisk the puree with eggs, sugar, half the cream, cinnamon, ground ginger and nutmeg.Pour into the crust and bake at 170°C until just set.Cool, whip the remaining cream softly and serve.DrinksHome for Thanksgiving apple cider punchCloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange.Poured when Neal lets Del in from the snowHow to make it1.5 L cloudy apple juice3 cinnamon sticks6 cloves1 orange, sliced2 tbsp brown sugar120ml bourbonPut the apple juice, two cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange and sugar in a saucepan.Simmer gently for 15 minutes without boiling.Strain into a jug and pour into four mugs.Add bourbon to each adult mug and serve with a fresh cinnamon stick.
